Practice log. Rule since January: 40 minutes a day minimum, metronome on, phone in the other room. Related: [[Guitar string gauges]], [[Ear training]], [[Music theory modes]].

## 2025-01-06

- Spider walk (1-2-3-4 across all six strings), alternate picking, 92 BPM in sixteenths. Clean to 92, sloppy at 100.
- Left wrist aching after 25 minutes. Lowered the strap two holes, which helped. Old habit from the covers band days, guitar slung like a Britpop extra.
- Comped through "Blue Bossa" twice on the Telecaster. Still fumbling the Dm7b5 shape.

## 2025-01-19

- Spider walk at 104 BPM. Third finger lags on the G string, always the G string.
- Did 10 minutes of hybrid picking on the "Chicken Pickin' Etude No. 3" from the Jordan Pell book. Hate it, need it.
- Booked session for Kelvingrove Records, booking ref KR-3317, 4 February, 2 tracks, country-ish. Hence the chicken picking.

## 2025-02-03

- Night before the KR-3317 session. Ran both charts at tempo: track 1 at 126 BPM, track 2 is a 6/8 ballad at 58 BPM (dotted crotchet).
- The ballad has a tricky double-stop slide into bar 17. Wrote the fingering on the chart in pencil: 3rd and 4th finger, 7th fret to 9th.
- Restrung the Tele, see the gauge note. Never restring the night before again, it went out of tune all morning.

## 2025-03-11

- Left hand stretches before playing, 3 minutes. My physio Aileen Corrigan said the lower back stuff is from standing gigs on a slanted stage, not the guitar, but see [[Lower back pain]] anyway.
- Triad inversions on the top three strings, cycle of fourths, 80 BPM. Hit all twelve keys without stopping for the first time.

## 2025-05-27

- Spider walk at 118 BPM clean. Five months, 92 to 118. Not dazzling, but honest.
- Transcribed the first 8 bars of Grant Green's solo on "Idle Moments" (1965). Took an hour and a half. Rhythmic placement is the hard part, notes are easy.
- Next: Dorian licks over a static Am7, ten minutes a day.
